title: Sound Exchange
blurb: Press a playlist into a battle creature. The title shapes its body; every song adds a part, stats, a move and a sound. Fight rivals in rhythm-timed JRPG battles while the music follows your genre mix.
controls: Add tracks (or tap a sample) and press. In battle pick a move, then tap the screen (or Space) on the beat to power it up; when the foe attacks, tap on the beat to guard.
